title: Explainer: How Nike’s Innovative Foams Deliver Performance and Comfort
summary: Nike’s best-in-class suite of midsole foams deliver standout energy return, plush cushioning, staunch stability and critical impact protection. Just as important: With each step, they bring comfort and confidence, no matter the sport or terrain. When creating Nike’s latest footwear innovations, engineers and designers have a toolbox of proprietary options to choose from to design the ideal shoe. Here’s how to understand the benefits of each.
